artifact_validation.derivation: all expected names, table rows, report content, and trade-off equality were required

configuration_restored.derivation: required true after all rebound configuration paths are compared

effective_raster_resolution_m.derivation: finite effective cell size recorded after raster read-back

final_stage.derivation: canonical report stage, required to equal complete

final_status.derivation: canonical report status, required to equal completed

initial_failed_run_id.derivation: earliest preserved failed attempt by started_at
initial_failed_run_id.selector: $.run_id where $.status=failed and transfer study area matches

initial_failed_stage.derivation: recorded terminal stage of the preserved failed attempt

preset_count.derivation: length after matching the canonical preset list to source configuration

primary_snapshot_unchanged.derivation: required true after before/after fingerprint validation

raster_height.derivation: raster dimension read back and recorded by transfer validation

raster_width.derivation: raster dimension read back and recorded by transfer validation

requested_raster_resolution_m.derivation: finite requested cell size recorded by acquisition

run_id.derivation: canonical completed run identifier, resolved dynamically

scenario_count.derivation: length after matching the canonical expected and completed scenario lists to source configuration

scored_count.derivation: single count shared by all completed scenarios and cross-checked against run-scoped risk tables

tradeoff_row_count.derivation: validated scenario-by-preset Cartesian product and matched to the canonical scenario rows

unscored_count.derivation: single count shared by all completed scenarios; not coerced to scored zeroes

unscored_geoids.derivation: single validated identifier set shared by all completed scenarios

mapped_placeholder_count.derivation: count whose key exists in paper_keys with complete evidence

quantitative_placeholder_count.derivation: count after rejecting generic and duplicate placeholders

remaining_prose_todo_count.derivation: counted separately from quantitative placeholders so mapping cannot imply the paper is complete
remaining_prose_todo_count.selector: line scan for explicit TODO/TBD, bracketed author placeholders, and template instructions
